Local PDF export dependencies

pdf-lib 1.17.1, by Andrew Dillon and contributors (MIT).
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
Unmodified dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js; licence in pdf-lib-LICENSE.txt.

@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1, by Andrew Dillon and contributors, based on
fontkit by Devon Govett (MIT, as declared in the distributed package).
https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
Unmodified dist/fontkit.umd.min.js from npm @pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1.
The package distributes its licence declaration in its README, reproduced
in fontkit-README.md. The bundled pako notice is in pako-LICENSE.txt.

DejaVu Sans, unmodified DejaVuSans.ttf from DejaVu fonts.
https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/
Bitstream Vera licence and public-domain DejaVu changes; see DejaVu-LICENSE.txt.

These files are loaded from this website only when PDF export is requested.
There is no PDF service, analytics call or runtime CDN dependency.
